strongest_counterhypothesis: CCF is merely known semantic commutativity/conflict analysis plus a dynamic graph; the cognitive architecture layer earns no distinct value, pair checks cost too much, and real Frank has too little eligible pure deterministic state for useful coverage.
what_proxy_refutes: Within the synthetic eligible transition class, local sparse semantic commutation is not dominated by conservative read/write conflict analysis or full-state replay: it exactly matches replay, exposes more safe independence, and is materially cheaper than whole-state replay.
what_proxy_does_not_refute: The primitive is known prior art; a conventional compiler scheduler may subsume the mechanism; eligible real-Frank coverage is unmeasured; system-level cognition/task benefit is unmeasured; opaque/stochastic/UI transitions may force UNKNOWN often enough to erase gains.
next_falsifier: Instrument frozen H1/H2 episodes to measure what fraction of internal transitions satisfy exact CCF eligibility and compare CCF transient-cell scheduling against GWT-only and compiler-semantic-commutativity baselines under matched latency/resource/recovery budgets.
promotion_effect: candidate stays possibility-only; no Harness or BASE semantic promotion
